---
format: docx
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    probe.opt: "from-yaml-opts-chunk"
  opts_knit:
    probe.knit: "from-yaml-opts-knit"
  knit_hooks:
    probe_hook: "ignored?"
  opts_hooks:
    probe_opt_hook: "ignored?"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
writeLines(c(
  paste("opts_chunk probe.opt=", knitr::opts_chunk$get("probe.opt")),
  paste("opts_knit probe.knit=", knitr::opts_knit$get("probe.knit")),
  paste("knit_hooks has probe_hook=", !is.null(knitr::knit_hooks$get("probe_hook"))),
  paste("opts_hooks has probe_opt_hook=", "probe_opt_hook" %in% names(knitr::opts_hooks$get()))
), "probe.txt")
```
